dateline: Las Vegas, NV — BTS at 52nd American Music Awards tonight (MGM Grand Garden Arena); ARIRANG World Tour Night 3 at Allegiant Stadium Wednesday (May 27)
heroHeadline: Day 4,729: BTS at 52nd AMAs Tonight — First US Award Show in Four Years, 'SWIM' Sets Global Excl. US Record
heroSubtitle: May 25, 2026 is Day 4,729 since BTS's June 13, 2013 debut. Today is a rest day between ARIRANG World Tour Nights 2 and 3, with all attention focused on BTS's highly anticipated 'special live appearance' at the 52nd American Music Awards at MGM Grand Garden Arena — their first US televised award show appearance in approximately four years. The band holds three nominations: Artist of the Year, Song of the Summer ('SWIM'), and Best Male K-Pop Artist. Gold Derby had BTS favored for Artist of the Year entering the ceremony. The convergence of the ARIRANG World Tour's historic Las Vegas residency (Nights 3 and 4 on May 27–28 at Allegiant Stadium) and the AMAs — both in Las Vegas — makes this a landmark Memorial Day weekend for BTS's global return. On the charts, 'SWIM' reached its sixth No. 1 on the Billboard Global Excl. US chart in 2026, surpassing Taylor Swift's previous annual record on that chart. 'SWIM' also holds No. 2 on the Global 200 and No. 34 on the US Hot 100 (8th consecutive charting week), while ARIRANG sits at No. 8 on the Billboard 200 in its 9th consecutive charting week.
